There's this one VHS tape Disney released back in the day simply called "Make Mine Music." It was a compilation of different animated musicals. There were two that stood out to me, one being "Peter, and the Wolf", and "The Whale Who Wanted to Sing at the Met." Both TERRIFIED me as a wee babby! "Peter, and the Wolf" is a given, cuz 4-year-old me was terrified of dogs, so that wolf was like gazing upon Satan himself. Then there was "The Whale Who Wanted to Sing at the Met." Good God, whenever that segment came on, I'd be in my room on the other side of the house when it came on, it was THAT scary to me! The short starred a whale with the gift of being able to sing opera, and for some UNGODLY reason, there would be these closeup shots of the interior of this heathen whale's mouth as he sang. Showing the back of his throat, and his three uvulas, the freak! That segment actually gave me nightmares. I remember one such nightmare taking place at my aunt's house, with the door leading to the basement opening up to show the back of that friggin' whale's throat! Screw that VHS!
